transform_audio_transcription_request: transform an audio transcription request into ElevenLabs API form data and file payload
transform_audio_transcription_response: transform a raw ElevenLabs speech-to-text response into OpenAI-compatible TranscriptionResponse format
map_openai_params: map OpenAI audio transcription parameters to ElevenLabs-compatible parameter names
get_complete_url: build the ElevenLabs speech-to-text API endpoint URL from a base URL and model
validate_environment: validate ElevenLabs API key and inject authentication headers for the request
